description: List initiatives in the user's Linear workspace

cursor.description: Omit for the first page. To continue, pass the previous response's cursor when hasNextPage is true

customView.description: Saved view ID, URL, slug, or exact name. Use list_custom_views to discover views. Applies saved filters and scope; other filters narrow the results. Uses list ordering, not saved display settings

fields.description: Fields to include in each result. Explicitly requested fields with no value return null. `id` is always included. Omit or pass an empty array for the default response.

leadTeam.description: Lead team name, key, or ID

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

orderBy.description: Timestamp to sort results by: creation time or last update time

parentInitiative.description: Parent initiative. Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug

title: List initiatives
